inferenceBasis: The exact measured APK reaches AUTH_UPDATER only after database bootstrap, socket readiness, generated-credential, system-table, collation/Unicode, transaction rollback, 27-table import and auth --version checks succeed. The report does not retain individual receipts for those earlier commands.
observedFailureCause: Unavailable: prior report omitted native invocation exit codes and relevant auth error categories. AUTH_UPDATER spans original DB setup, updater and post-DB dry-run initialization.
sourceDefectIdentifiedSeparately: MySQLConnection::Open mutates the pool-shared socket host after the first connection, so the next connection can incorrectly parse a socket pathname as a numeric port. This is a source-proven defect consistent with the failure, not a cause confirmed by the old device log.
